text.div: Codes StreamRecord needs that the OneAquaHealth temporary CodeSystem (IG commit b907cf0) does not have.

concept.definition: Observation category: reported by a member of the public with no training, unverified.
Refines OAH "foam" (Foam/colour/smell) so foam and colour/smell can be answered separately.
Question code for the multi-select of scum, dead fish and standing water.
A coloured film or scum on the surface. Not a confirmed cyanobacterial bloom.
One or more dead fish seen in or by the water.
Still water pools near the stream (possible mosquito breeding).
None of the other signs, or none of the feelings, apply.
Question code for the resident's overall view, answered with the OneAquaHealth Citizen Science App's own codes (GOOD, MODERATE, POOR) from the ENORA API.

concept.display: How the resident feels at the stream
concept.definition: Question code for the feelings the OneAquaHealth app asks about, to relate ecosystem quality to wellbeing.
The resident feels joy at the stream.
The resident feels calm (serenity) at the stream.
The resident feels angry at the state of the stream.
The resident feels afraid or uneasy at the stream.
